# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 24 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 24 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_024_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 24

**24:1** Now I, James, who wrote this history, when there arose a tumult in Jerusalem at the death of Herod, withdrew into the wilderness until the tumult in Jerusalem ceased. I glorified the Lord God who gave me the wisdom to write this history.

**24:2** And grace shall be with all those who fear the Lord. Amen.
